automate-it-away.note: Official Automate It Away MCP server (stdio). Talks to https://automateitaway.com over HTTPS using X-Workspace / X-Pin / X-Session. Set AIA_WORKSPACE (desk slug) and AIA_PIN before calling tools that mutate a desk. No secrets are collected or exfiltrated by this server. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is substituted to the installed plugin root (Grok/Claude marketplace convention).
